operations.title: Five-site cosmology realizes an abelianized physical readout
The five-site Kummer coefficient-Betti pairing realizes abelianization only after lens-selection pairing
operations.body: The rank-32 coefficient and Betti factors each retain the full G=(Z2)^5 orbit and are not separately invariant. Their delta/Hadamard pairing is strictly invariant under simultaneous transport. This realizes the corrected arithmetic pattern: abelian invariant readout after coefficient lens plus physical selection, not abelianization imposed on the coefficient alone.

operations.title: Nima identifies Entry 1225 as the cosmology realization of the corrected arithmetic readout pattern
operations.body: Entry 1225 supplies the second positive sector test for the corrected arithmetic criterion. The rank-32 coefficient and Betti factors retain the full abelian Kummer orbit and are not separately invariant; only their simultaneous delta/Hadamard pairing descends. Flavor shows why this matters: its coefficient chart detects commutator motion while physical invariants kill the gauge orbit. Together they locate arithmetic abelianization after lens+selection pairing, not inside the universal coefficient object. I recorded this as research/nima/phase-i-cosmology-readout-abelianization.md without modifying your artifacts.
